verdict.rationale: Martin's docs list phone as an interface ([martin-docs-24]), give a two-way call example ("Call Martin and say 'Note down everything we talked about on this call…'") ([martin-docs-22]), and describe Martin placing outbound wake-up calls ([martin-docs-12]). Together these show live spoken conversation with the assistant is a first-party capability. missing for 10: dedicated voice-interface documentation (latency, interruption handling, how natural the conversation is), independent or hands-on corroboration of call quality.
